Precondition: Config Tool open at Quality > Defect Codes
Step: Create a new defect code and edit an existing one
Expected Result: Code is created and saved; edits persist; changes are audited (config log)

Precondition: A defect code open in the editor
Step: Set the code's Area and IsExcused flag
Expected Result: Defect code carries Code, Description, Area association, and IsExcused; IsExcused feeds future OEE quality math

Step: Verify the FRS Appendix E defect codes were seeded
Expected Result: Defect codes loaded from Appendix E (153 rows), each associated with an area (Die Cast, Machine Shop, Trim Shop, Production Control, Quality Control, HSP) with IsExcused set per the appendix
Code is soft-deleted (DeprecatedAt) and drops out of active lists; historical references are retained
Only Die Cast area defect codes are offered

Step: Open the defect picker on a Machine Shop screen
Expected Result: Only Machine Shop codes are shown; Die Cast-only codes are absent

Step: Verify the downtime reason codes were seeded
Expected Result: 353 downtime reason codes loaded from FRS Appendix D; each carries code, description, area, reason type, and IsExcused

Precondition: A downtime reason code in the list
Expected Result: Code, description, area, reason type, and IsExcused are all present

Step: Review the seeded downtime reason types
Expected Result: Six reason types present: Equipment, Miscellaneous, Mold, Quality, Setup, Unscheduled

Precondition: Downtime entry screen at a machine
Step: Open the reason-type selector then pick a code
Expected Result: Operator selects the reason type first (from the six seeded types), then the specific code within that type
